actionResult.summary: Revised E1 Explore closes E1-RE-001 and E1-RE-002 with disposable next-consumer proofs. Post-pass architecture remediation is now explicitly bound to the current non-accepted Actual/Compare cycle and atomically invalidates stale Full Test/current architecture qualification before entering the ordinary required Change lifecycle; after checkpoint it returns only to awaiting-user-decision and requires fresh Owner Full Test authorization before a new Actual cycle. Accepted Actual promotion is now proved through a serializable prior-Delivery source fact, fresh durable read/resume, and a different future Delivery Current derived from the accepted prior Actual plus the future Delivery's own exact Git Start revision; exact managed Archify validates/delivers both prior Actual and future Current, with no global system.architecture.json or 03-specific constants. No Proposal or implementation mutation is performed.
